test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 18th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The carpenter used a **plane **to smooth the surface.

options.text: The plane landed safely at night.
The plane of geometry is complex.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"plane"** in the highlighted sentence refers to a tool used by carpenters to smooth wooden surfaces. (हिंदी में: रंदा) • **Example:** The carpenter used a plane to smooth the rough edges of the wooden plank. • In the correct option (Option 1), the word **"plane"** is used as a homonym, referring to an aircraft that flies in the air. (हिंदी में: हवाई जहाज) • **Example:** The plane took off from the runway and soared into the sky. • Homonyms are words that have the same spelling or pronunciation but different meanings. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2:** The plane of geometry is complex. (हिंदी में: समतल या स्तर) • **Example:** Understanding the plane in geometry involves studying two-dimensional surfaces. • **Option 3:** The carpenter sharpened his tools. (हिंदी में: बढ़ई ने अपने औज़ार तेज़ किए।) • **Example:** The carpenter sharpened his plane to ensure a smooth finish. • **Option 4:** The surface was rough earlier. (हिंदी में: सतह पहले खुरदरी थी।) • **Example:** After polishing, the surface became smooth and shiny. 3a:T91f, The correct answer is **Option 1**.
